name: one-api
untestable_note: The harness does not configure a Bedrock upstream channel. Native Cohere and Bedrock ingress paths return the web dashboard (HTTP 200 text/html), not protocol responses, on the pinned v0.6.10 image; they are withheld because this frozen engine cannot distinguish that fallback from a successful protocol probe. This is a harness limitation, not a measured gateway failure. OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini channel probes otherwise run normally.
